input:
The statement pattern p → ~ (p ∧ ~ q) is equivalent to

Options:
A. q
B. (~ p) ∨ q
C. (~ p) ∧ q
D. (~ p) ∨ (~ q)

phase_1_understand_the_problem.problem_restatement: Simplify the logical statement pattern p → ~(p ∧ ~q) using logical equivalence rules.
phase_1_understand_the_problem.key_observation: Use conditional law p → r ≡ ~p ∨ r, then De Morgan's laws and absorption/idempotent laws to simplify.

phase_3_plan_the_approach.strategy: Apply conditional law, then De Morgan's law, and simplify using associative and idempotent laws.
logical_steps: Step 1: Rewrite p → ~(p ∧ ~q) as ~p ∨ ~(p ∧ ~q) using conditional law
Step 2: Apply De Morgan's law to ~(p ∧ ~q) to get ~p ∨ q

phase_5_verify_answer.verification: p → ~(p ∧ ~q) ≡ p → (~p ∨ q) ≡ ~p ∨ (~p ∨ q) ≡ ~p ∨ q. Equivalent to (~p) ∨ q ✓
